questions.title: Banning Private Cars in Downtown City Centers
questions.prompt: Some city planners believe private gasoline and diesel vehicles should be banned from downtown urban centers to combat air pollution and traffic congestion, while critics argue this hurts small businesses and inconveniences suburban commuters. What is your opinion on banning cars from downtown centers?
keyPoints: Environmental & public health benefits: cleaner air, lower carbon footprint, safer pedestrian zones
Economic & transit requirements: must be paired with affordable, reliable public transit systems and commercial delivery windows
Impact on urban vibrancy: successful pedestrian streets in Europe boost foot traffic to shops and cafes

questions.title: Free Tuition for All University Students
questions.prompt: Should post-secondary university education be fully funded by government taxes and provided free to all students, or should students continue paying tuition fees? Give your opinion and support it with two developed reasons.
keyPoints: Equal opportunity & socioeconomic mobility: removes crippling student debt and allows students from all backgrounds to thrive
Economic productivity: an educated workforce attracts high-tech industries and generates higher long-term tax revenues
Fiscal counterarguments: costs must be balanced by maintaining high academic standards and preventing tax spikes

questions.title: Legal Right to Disconnect After Working Hours
questions.prompt: Many jurisdictions are introducing 'Right to Disconnect' laws that prohibit employers from contacting employees via email or phone outside regular business hours. Do you agree or disagree with legally enforcing this policy? State your opinion with reasons.
keyPoints: Mental health & burnout prevention: constant availability blurs boundaries and leads to chronic stress and exhaustion
Quality family and leisure time: protected personal hours restore focus and actually improve daytime workplace productivity
Practical flexibility: emergency exceptions can be outlined while maintaining general respect for downtime

questions.title: Eliminating Traditional Letter Grades in K-12 Schools
questions.prompt: Some educational experts argue that traditional letter grades (A, B, C, D, F) should be replaced with competency-based assessments and qualitative feedback, arguing that grades create unnecessary anxiety. Do you agree or disagree with replacing letter grades?
keyPoints: Focus on real mastery vs. memorization: qualitative feedback helps students understand how to improve rather than chasing numbers
Reduces toxic comparison and anxiety: encourages genuine curiosity and resilience in children
Need for standardization: clear rubrics are still necessary for university admissions and tracking progress

questions.title: Remote Work vs. Mandatory Return to Office
questions.prompt: Many major corporations are mandating that employees return to the office full-time, arguing it fosters spontaneous collaboration and corporate culture. Do you think companies should mandate in-office work or allow permanent flexible remote work?
keyPoints: Productivity & work-life balance: eliminating hours in traffic gives workers more energy and flexibility
Access to diverse global talent: companies can hire the best individuals regardless of geographical location
Intentional collaboration: hybrid team meetups can preserve company culture without forcing daily commutes

questions.title: Imposing Special Taxes on Sugary and Fast Foods
questions.prompt: Should governments place a special health tax on sugary drinks, candy, and fast food to combat obesity and fund public healthcare, or is this an unfair infringement on consumer freedom? State your opinion.
keyPoints: Reduction in chronic disease: proven to lower consumption of harmful ultra-processed foods (similar to tobacco taxes)
Funding public healthcare: tax revenues can subsidize fresh produce and community athletic facilities
Protection of children: discourages aggressive marketing of unhealthy foods to youth

questions.title: Free Fare Public Transit for All Citizens
questions.prompt: Should public transit (buses, subways, light rail) be completely free of charge for all passengers and funded entirely through tax dollars? State your opinion and explain your reasoning.
keyPoints: Massive traffic reduction: motivates drivers to leave cars at home, reducing gridlock and greenhouse gases
Social equity: provides immediate financial relief to low-income workers, students, and seniors
Operational efficiency: eliminates costly fare gates, card readers, and enforcement personnel

questions.title: Use of Generative AI Tools in Academic Testing
questions.prompt: With the rise of artificial intelligence writing and coding assistants, some universities are banning AI tools entirely, while others encourage students to use them ethically. Do you believe AI tools should be banned or integrated into education?
keyPoints: Preparation for the modern workforce: future careers require proficiency in collaborating with AI technologies
Transformation of assessment methods: tests can evaluate critical thinking, oral defense, and practical problem-solving
Equity in learning: AI tutors can provide personalized, 24/7 educational guidance to students needing extra help

questions.title: A Mandatory 4-Day Work Week (32 Hours)
questions.prompt: Several countries and forward-thinking corporations have tested a mandatory 4-day (32-hour) workweek with no reduction in pay, reporting equal or higher productivity and happier employees. Critics argue this harms customer service and raises costs for small businesses. What is your opinion on adopting a 4-day workweek?
keyPoints: Productivity & mental health: reduced burnout leads to higher focus during working hours and fewer sick days
Environmental & family benefits: fewer weekly commutes reduce traffic emissions, while parents save on childcare costs
Operational flexibility: businesses can stagger shifts across Monday-Friday to maintain customer availability

questions.title: Imposing a Special Robot and Automation Tax
questions.prompt: As artificial intelligence and automated robotics replace human workers in manufacturing, transport, and customer service, some economists advocate taxing companies that deploy robots to fund retraining programs for displaced workers. Do you support or oppose a tax on automation?
keyPoints: Protection of the social safety net: compensates for lost income tax revenue and funds universal basic income or retraining
Technological innovation counterargument: excessive taxation might stifle technological progress and drive companies to other countries
Balanced transition: targeted subsidies for human-AI collaboration rather than punitive barriers against efficiency

questions.title: Mandatory Financial Literacy in High Schools
questions.prompt: Many high school graduates understand complex trigonometry or historic dates but have no knowledge of filing income taxes, managing credit card interest, or applying for a mortgage. Should practical personal financial literacy be a compulsory requirement for high school graduation?
keyPoints: Prevention of youth debt traps: understanding compound interest and credit scores prevents crippling student and consumer debt
Socioeconomic equity: levels the playing field for young people whose parents cannot teach financial planning at home
Lifelong economic empowerment: basic investing and budgeting skills foster entrepreneurial ambition and financial independence

questions.title: Complete Ban on Single-Use Plastics
questions.prompt: To combat microplastic pollution in oceans and landfills, several governments have banned single-use plastic bags, straws, and food containers. Critics claim this causes inconvenience and forces businesses to use expensive paper alternatives. In your opinion, should single-use plastics be banned completely?
keyPoints: Ecological urgency: non-biodegradable plastics persist for centuries, harming marine wildlife and entering human food chains
Catalyst for circular packaging innovation: encourages reusable containers, biodegradable seaweed packaging, and durable tote bags
Public health advantages: reduces chemical leaching from heated plastic food containers

questions.title: Government Regulation of Social Media for Youths
questions.prompt: With rising rates of teenage anxiety, cyberbullying, and sleep deprivation linked to smartphone use, some lawmakers propose banning social media algorithms from recommending content to users under 18 or setting mandatory screen-time limits. Do you agree or disagree with regulating social media for minors?
keyPoints: Child psychological safety: predatory algorithms exploit dopamine feedback loops and exacerbate body image and anxiety issues
Parental vs. state responsibility: parents need enforceable digital tools and platform transparency to guide healthy habits
Educational and creative benefits: platforms must balance child safety without cutting young people off from creative communities

questions.title: Increasing Public Funding for Municipal Libraries
questions.prompt: In the digital age where books are easily downloaded on tablets, some people argue that public tax funding for libraries should be reduced, while advocates argue modern libraries provide essential community spaces, free Wi-Fi, and social support. What is your opinion on funding public libraries?
keyPoints: Crucial community hubs: libraries offer free internet, warm study spaces, newcomer ESL classes, and children's literacy programs
Bridging the digital divide: provides computers, 3D printers, and digital tools to low-income residents who lack home access
Democratization of knowledge: preserves independent research archives, local history, and reliable information beyond paywalls

questions.title: Phasing Out Traditional Zoos and Marine Parks
questions.prompt: Animal welfare organizations argue that keeping wild animals (such as lions, elephants, and killer whales) in cages and artificial tanks for human entertainment is unethical and should be phased out in favor of wildlife sanctuaries. What is your opinion on traditional zoos?
keyPoints: Animal rights & psychological well-being: wild species experience chronic stress, confinement depression, and shortened lifespans in captivity
Modern conservation alternatives: virtual reality exhibits, wildlife rescue sanctuaries, and habitat preservation in the wild are more ethical
Educational evolution: public empathy is better cultivated through immersive nature documentaries than watching pacing caged animals

questions.title: Abolishing Tipping in Restaurants in Favor of Living Wages
questions.prompt: In North America, restaurant diners are typically expected to add an 18-20% tip to their bill to compensate servers who earn low base wages. Some propose eliminating tipping entirely and raising menu prices to guarantee all staff fair, predictable living wages with benefits. What is your opinion?
keyPoints: Income stability & dignity: eliminates wage volatility caused by slow shifts, weather, or customer bias, ensuring predictable paychecks
Reduces wage disparities: bridges the unfair compensation gap between front-of-house servers and back-of-house kitchen cooks
Transparent pricing: customers know the exact price of their meal without confusing social guilt or mental math at checkout
